---
type: recipe
title: Sourdough Loaf
description: levain autolyse and open crumb
tags: [food]
---

A good sourdough loaf starts with bread flour, water, salt, and a ripe
levain. Mix the flour and water and rest the shaggy mass for an hour.

The autolyse step hydrates flour before salt tightens the gluten network,
which shortens kneading and improves extensibility for shaping later.

Fold the dough every half hour during bulk fermentation until it holds
its shape. A long cold retard in the fridge develops flavor overnight.

Bake covered to trap steam, then uncover for a crisp caramelized crust
with an open airy crumb full of irregular holes.
